main.allSettingsDefault: All settings are already at their default values.
main.changeTextCase: Which text case would you like to use?
main.documentDescription: Mathematical Function Analyzer developed in JavaScript and TypeScript.
main.noHistory: There is no history of changes yet.
main.noHistoryExp: You have entered only one Function so far. Use “Change” to enter another Function.
main.noteAccents: Note: Disabling this option removes accents from words, which may cause ambiguity.
main.noteDecimalPlaces:
Note₁: Too few decimal places may reduce calculation accuracy.
Note₂: Existing numbers will be rounded to the new number of decimal places.
main.noteDecimalSeparator: Note₁: This changes numbers written with “.” to “,”, for example:
main.noteDecimalSeparator2:
Note₂: This is only a visual change and does not affect calculations.
Note₃: You will also be able to enter numbers using “,” instead of “.”.
main.noteDegrees:
Note₁: This affects Trigonometric Functions such as Sine, Cosine, and Tangent.
Note₂: When enabled, angles are interpreted as degrees instead of π radians.
main.noteDivisionPrecision:
Note₁: This may affect calculations involving very small divisions.
Note₂: You must enter values such as “1e-12”.
main.noteErrors: Note: Disabling this option may prevent you from noticing mistakes.
main.noteExplanations:
Note₁: Enabling this option will make certain messages more detailed and include explanations, such as the Delta calculation: Δ = b² - 4 · a · c, instead of only the result.
Note₂: Not all messages have an explanatory version.
Note₃: If Unicode is disabled, this will be displayed as: Delta = b^2 - 4 * a * c.
main.noteInputConfirm: Note: Every value you enter will require confirmation.
main.noteIterationLimit:
Note₁: This affects all loops, including logarithms, menus, and similar operations.
Note₂: This setting helps prevent infinite loops if something goes wrong.
main.noteLanguage: Note: This changes the language of the entire Program.
main.noteLogPrecision:
Note₁: This may affect calculations involving very small Logarithmic values.
Note₂: You must enter values such as “1e-12”.
main.noteOutputConfirm: Note: A confirmation message will be shown before closing the Program.
main.noteRestoreDefault:
Note₁: This will affect all the settings listed above.
Note₂: This change is permanent.
main.noteSettingsExit: Note: Settings may be reset when the Program closes.
main.noteShowFunction:
Note₁: “Show Function” displays the Function (for example, ax² + bx + c) at the top of menus before the options.
Note₂: The Function will still be shown when option “6” (Review) is selected.
main.noteSimpleMulti:
Note₁: This changes polynomial expressions aesthetically, from “a · x² + b · x + c” to “ax² + bx + c”.
Note₂: If Unicode is disabled, “·” becomes “*”.
Note₃: This does not affect “×”, although Unicode will also replace it with “*”.
main.noteTextCase: Sets how the response text will be displayed.
main.noteUnicode:
Note₁: Unicode characters are special symbols, such as “ℝ”, “∀”, etc. Disabling them will replace them with corresponding words, such as “Reals”, “for all”, etc.
Note₂: Not all Unicode characters will be disabled.
Note₃: This setting may change some explanations.
